meta.method: Read named 2022 sources; one point per (source, location); pipeline/geocode.py inside AOI bbox; manual neighbourhood centre where Nominatim missed. Casualty numbers only where the source locates them.
meta.notes: Seven NEMA deaths kept at Alimosho LGA, not on a single street. Three sibling deaths attached only to the church building NEMA named. Punch/NAN two deaths at Oyatoki, Orile Agege kept separate from BBC Pidgin two missing at Oke Oba/Fatoki — sources do not identify them as the same people. Meiran/Abbatoir/Alagbado/Agege/Tollgate named as upstream sources of runoff, not as flooded streets. Vanguard 15 Jul names no neighbourhood. No locations, times, numbers or quotes were inferred beyond the text.
unresolved: Which of Oke Isagun / Agbado Oke / Oko LCDA contains Mercy of Christ Apostolic Church
Oyatoki vs Fatoki/Oke Oba: possibly the same Agege canal incident; not merged
BBC photo caption 'Opic estate' not geocoded (Isheri/Ogun ambiguity)
omitted: Vanguard 15 Jul 2022 (citywide rain; no named Lagos streets)
NEMA.gov.ng Alimosho assessment dated 8–9 Sep 2025 (wrong event)
Legit.ng Command Area flood 20 Feb 2024 (wrong event)
AIT Ikola clip dated Sep 2022 in Facebook metadata (not 8–9 Jul)
Meiran, Abbatoir, Alagbado, Agege, Tollgate as flood sites (CDA described inflow, not flooding there)
2022 season totals (16,000 families) unrelated to this weekend

review.notes: All points inside AOI; same-name places (Jakande Isolo/Lekki, Ajegunle Ajeromi/Ikorodu) kept distinct; Ijede placed in Ijede town (Ikorodu LGA). Quotes verified for every readable publisher; Channels TV, TheCable, Guardian NG unverifiable (blocked).
